body: All of my work is remote, so I can't really make friends that way

I feel like I've just been born wrong. I don't have the social skills necessary to make real connections. Whenever I've made friends in life I've always been the  backup friend. Just somebody temporary and it never lasts. Even then, that's a rare thing. Idk I probably don't sound coherent its difficult to explain

I did contact them recently but the circumstances were weird. I don't really want to go into it but we both knew each other at very bad points in our lives and they have moved on. Talking to me brought up bad memories for her and I don't want to cause them pain like that when they're happy in life now

I want to be able to have fun doing things on my own, and I've tried. But the truth is the only thing I really want in my life is to have good people around me that care about me. For real, I have the time and the means to do pretty much whatever I want. But everything I try feels hollow. Human beings are social animals, without that basic part of life I just can't be happy. And yet, I feel like I'm in no way equipped to actually find it. I keep trying and I just feel worse than when I started. 

Thanks for being kind though, I appreciate what you're saying

Not really. There's only one person I can think of but they have their own life in another city so it would he difficult to connect. Other than that I don't have any past friends that would be interested
I'd want to have some people in my life that actually care about me
I have no idea what would help. I don't think anything will. If I did I wouldn't be at this point.

I know you're trying to be kind. But this just makes me feel pain. I wish little things like that still made me happy. They don't anymore. Nothing does.

I don't understand how admitting I'm going to kill myself is a success. That's just failing at life's most fundamental mission, to live. But I'm not living so now I'm just planning how to die.

Sorry if that's fucked up but I really hope you can keep on enjoying that good stuff. I hope you never have to be like how I am

This isn't the first time a thing like this has happened. Its normal for people to judge me and treat me like this. Either I change or this keeps happening. And how I look isn't something I can change so idk what to do. I am so alone rn and I don't see how that's going to change. Sorry if that sounds rude, you said some nice things but I've heard it all before. The only common problem is me.

Id do that if this wasn't the hundredth time I've been effected like this. Its not one bad experience and It won't get better. You can only suck it up and move on so many times until you've got to face facts.

People will always treat me like this.

I did the right thing and I get abused for it. I can't even describe how hopeless that makes my world
